name: khposcommerce
description: KHPosCommerce - Unified Omnichannel POS & E-Commerce Ecosystem

scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n "API,ADMIN" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.dev:all: npx concurrently -n "API,SUPERADMIN,ADMIN,STORE" -c "blue,yellow,green,magenta" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:superadmin" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:storefront"
scripts.build: npm run build:admin && npm run build:storefront
scripts.setup: npm run setup:api && npm run setup:apps
scripts.setup:api: cd backend-khposcommerce && composer install && cp -n .env.example .env && php artisan key:generate
